title: Hazardous-drug handling under current USP standards
rule_summary: 247 CMR 9.01 requires a Massachusetts pharmacy licensee, unless otherwise regulated by the Board, to adhere to the most current standards established by each applicable USP chapter. Current USP <800> standards address hazardous-drug handling broadly, including receipt, storage, compounding, dispensing, administration, and disposal; hazardous-drug obligations therefore are not limited to the act of compounding.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate recognizes hazardous-drug controls during ordinary pharmacy operations even when no compounding occurs.
common_confusions: USP <800> hazardous-drug handling is broader than compounding alone.
Compliance with ordinary dispensing rules does not eliminate applicable hazardous-drug handling requirements.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
